GaneshaTracker Mysuru

Privacy Policy

Last updated: 16 September 2026
PrivacyTerms of Use

GaneshaTracker is a free community map of Ganesh Chaturthi celebrations across Mysuru. This page explains, in plain language, what information the site handles and how you can have anything removed.

Who runs this site

GaneshaTracker is a non-commercial community project maintained by SJ Ruthvik. For anything on this page, or to have a listing or photo taken down, write to contact@sjruthvik.in.

What we collect

Almost everything on the map is submitted by visitors through the "Add a Ganesha" form. When you add a listing, we store what you enter: the celebration's name, area, type, map location, timings, immersion date, organiser name, visitor access, a social or Instagram link, an optional "added by" credit, and any photo you upload.

Please only submit details of public celebrations, and photos you have the right to share. Do not add another person's private information without their permission.

What we do not collect

There are no user accounts, so we never ask for or store passwords. We do not run ads and do not use advertising or cross-site tracking. The "Buy me a filter coffee" button simply shows a UPI QR code so you can send a tip from your own payment app. Your payment happens entirely inside your bank or UPI app. We never see or store your card, bank, or UPI details.

Information kept in your browser

The site remembers a few things on your own device only, using your browser's local storage: which celebrations you have marked as favourites, and your chosen language (English or Kannada). This stays on your device, is not sent to us, and you can clear it any time from your browser settings.

Where your submissions are stored

To run the map, we rely on a small number of trusted service providers:

Supabase stores the listings and uploaded photos. Vercel hosts the website. OpenStreetMap provides the map tiles. When you tap "Directions," you are taken to Google Maps. These providers process data on their own infrastructure under their own privacy terms. Basic technical logs, such as IP addresses in server request logs, may be handled by the hosting providers as part of normal operation.

Why we can use your submission

Before submitting, you tick a box confirming you are allowed to share the public celebration you are adding. That confirmation, together with the community purpose of the site, is the basis on which your listing is shown.

Your choices and rights

If you want a listing, a photo, or a personal detail (such as an organiser name or an "added by" credit) corrected or removed, email contact@sjruthvik.in and we will act on it. Under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 you may ask what personal data of yours we hold and request its correction or deletion. Because there are no accounts, the fastest way to reach us is that email.

Children

This site is meant for a general audience and is not directed at children. Please do not submit personal information about children.

Changes to this policy

As the site grows, this policy may be updated. The date at the top shows when it last changed. Continued use of the site means you accept the current version.

This is a plain-language policy for a small community project, provided in good faith. It is not legal advice.
